method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18. A seat-neutral core (ita-individual.l4, with the dated table of indexed amounts in ita-amounts.l4: computations as functions, duties as DEONTIC rules) and a seat layer (ita-seat.l4: @export questions with @desc inputs) that imports it. No REFUSE: cases outside the encoding answer `not covered`, asserted. Checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Income Tax Act, R.S.C., 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.), Justice Laws consolidation current to 2026-09-30 (last amended 2026-06-18), from justicecanada/laws-lois-xml commit 0507465393c224c0491fc8c17c88340217acc656, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/R.S.C.-1985-c.-1-5th-Supp..txt; indexed 2026 amounts from the CRA's 'Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts' (page dated 2026-03-12), deposited 2026-10-24 at ../../registers/source-bundle/cra-indexation-adjustment-2026.txt, 2026 column (for the CCB: the months July 2026 to June 2027). Taxation year 2026 only.

seat: the individual (a person resident in Canada for 2026, alone or with a spouse or common-law partner, with or without children)
exports: What does my return come to
How much OAS recovery tax do I pay
How much Canada child benefit do I get
How much Canada workers benefit do I get
How much GST credit do I get
How many days do I have to tell the CRA
regulative_rules: the duty to file a return (s 150(1)(d), (1.1)(b), s 180.2(5)(a): by 30 April, or 15 June for a business; by the guardian or legal representative of a person unable to file)
the duty to pay the balance (s 156.1(4), s 180.2(5)(b): by the balance-due day, s 248(1))
the duty to pay each instalment (s 156(1), unless s 156.1(2)(b) applies: 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, 15 December)
the duty to notify the Minister of a change of cohabiting spouse or common-law partner (s 122.62(5)(a), (6)(a), (7)(a))

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run ita-amounts.l4 ; l4 run ita-individual.l4 ; l4 run ita-seat.l4 ; l4 run ita-cases.l4 ; l4 run ita-cases-seat.l4
checks.result: 130 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (98 in ita-cases.l4 + 32 in ita-cases-seat.l4), 2026-10-24; four #TRACEs breach on purpose (-- expect: comments) and were read in the diagnostics
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Taxation year 2026, the individual resident in Canada: s 2(1), (2); s 3; s 5(1); s 8 (one figure); s 56(1)(a)(i)(A), (B), (a)(iv), (u); s 60(e.1), (i), (w); s 110(1)(f); s 117(2); s 146(5); s 118(1)(a)-(c), (1.1), (2), (3), (4)(a), (5) (a fact), (7), (8), (10), (11); s 118.3(1); s 118.7(a), (b); s 122.5(1), (2), (3.005), (4.5), (4.6), (5); s 122.6; s 122.61(1); s 122.62(1), (5)-(7); s 122.7(1), (1.3), (2), (3), (5); s 150(1)(d), (1.1)(b); s 156(1); s 156.1(1), (2)(b), (4); s 180.2(1), (2), (5); s 248(1) appropriate percentage, balance-due day; s 250(1), (3); s 257. Not covered (explicit answers): other years and benefit months; non-residents and part-year residents; Quebec residents' tax (s 120(2)); taxable capital gains; deceased individuals; shared-custody parents; the CWB in Alberta, Quebec and Nunavut (s 122.71); the s 122.7(3) D(b)/D(c) overlap. Out: caregiver, medical, gifts, tuition and transfer credits; CWB advance payments; s 180.2(3)-(4) withholding; refunds, interest and penalties; provincial tax.
